title: Instructions for projects under SFURTI Schemes - regarding.
text: File No: 4/69/2016-KVI-1 Government of India Ministry of Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi-11 0011 Dated the 29th Nov, 2017 ()6j11~, . CIRCULAR Subject: Instructions for projects under SFURTI Schemes - regarding. +++++++++++++ The Scheme Steering Committee of SFURTI in its 25th meeting held on 24.10.2017 has laid emphasis on the following for compliance of approved/new projects under SFURTIScheme: - • All presentations must focus on the IRR and financial viability of the projects and should be specific and focussed. • All remaining approved clusters must be completed within March 2018. All possible steps must be taken to speed up the process of setting up of CFCs and procurement of machineries within the prescribed timelines. 2. These instructions may be strictly followed.
